svg.title: The station above the city, with a shuttle on final approach
svg.desc: A technical elevation on black. At the back, the city and its launch yard below the horizon at y 860, drawn in one-point perspective. Behind and in front of the station, orbital traffic on dotted tracks. Between them the station: a truss spine, habitat rings, solar wings, a gantry. Dust haze at one pixel in the air behind the station. In front of it all, the action: a shuttle on final approach to a docking hoop, an alignment beam between its nose and the hoop, two drones crossing the frame on lit paths, and a signal pulse travelling the truss.
